storefront.heroTagline: Made by hand, one piece at a time
storefront.preorderCartNotice: Your cart has a preorder item. It will ship once it's ready, and we'll contact you with the date.
storefront.step1Body: Browse the collection and pick what fits your story.
storefront.step2Body: Send your details. No online payment needed.
storefront.step3Title: We bring it to your door
storefront.step3Body: We confirm your order and deliver it to you.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.orderPlacedBody: We've received your order and will contact you shortly to confirm delivery.
checkout.preorderPlacedBody: This is a preorder. We'll contact you to confirm the shipping date.

pnl.title: Profit & Loss
pnl.openOrdersNote: Not counted as profit until they are delivered.
pnl.missingCost: {{n}} delivered order(s) have no cost recorded, so profit may look higher than it really is. Add a cost price to your products.
pnl.note: Revenue counts delivered orders only. Expenses come from the Expenses screen.

login.resetSent: If this email has an account, we've sent a link to reset the password.

signup.title: Create your shop
signup.intro: This sets up your storefront and your partner login in one step.
signup.taken: The shop name "{{name}}" is already taken. Try a more specific name.
signup.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
signup.weakPassword: Password should be at least 6 characters.
signup.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signup.network: Network error — please check your connection and try again.
signup.generic: Something went wrong creating your shop. Please try again.
signup.closed: Creating new shops is closed for now.

landing.body: Build a simple storefront and mini business dashboard for your handmade or small-batch product — no coding needed.

dash.lowStock: ⚠ {{n}} product(s) low or out of stock — review Products
dash.productsDesc: Add, edit, and manage what's for sale.
dash.expensesDesc: Log costs like materials and shipping.
dash.pnlDesc: Sales, cost and profit at a glance.
dash.settingsDesc: Colors, logo and the home page banner.
dash.promosDesc: Create discount codes for your customers.
dash.activityDesc: See who changed what, and when.
dash.teamDesc: Give each person their own login and role.

products.costHint: Private: what one unit costs you. Customers never see this.
products.preorderCheck: This is a preorder product (customers can order it even when stock is 0)
products.badCost: Enter a valid cost price (or leave it empty).
products.saveFailed: Could not save the product. Please try again.
products.confirmDelete: Remove this product? It will disappear from the storefront but past orders stay intact.
products.lowBanner: {{n}} product(s) low or out of stock — check the badges below.
products.none: No products yet. Add your first one above.
products.shippingExtraHint: Added to the shipping fee for each unit of this product (for big or heavy items).
products.galleryHelp: Extra photos shown as small pictures under the main one. A color or choice can also have its own picture (in Options): the big picture changes when the customer picks it.
products.relatedHelp: Shown on this product's page as "Extensions and accessories". Each one is still a normal product that can be bought on its own.

orders.noCostRecorded: No cost was recorded for this order.
orders.confirmCancel: Cancel this order? Stock for its items will be restored automatically.

err.ALREADY_DELIVERED: This order was already delivered and cannot be cancelled.

expenses.saveFailed: Could not save the expense. Please try again.

settingsPage.accentHelp: Used for buttons, highlights and links on your shop. The shop is always dark; only this color changes.
settingsPage.logoHelp: Paste a link to your logo image (a transparent PNG or SVG works best). Until you add one, the shop name is shown as text.
settingsPage.bannerHelp: The big picture at the top of your shop. Add one slide for a still banner, or up to {{max}} for a slideshow that changes by itself. Change the pictures here whenever you like. If you add none, the first product photo is used.
settingsPage.timingNote: Only used when you have 2 or more slides.
settingsPage.saved: Saved. Open your storefront to see the changes.
settingsPage.errHttps: Image links must start with https://
settingsPage.errSave: Could not save. Please try again.
settingsPage.checkoutHelp: Choose which details you ask customers for. Name and phone are always required because you need them to deliver.
settingsPage.shippingHelp: Add the places you deliver to and the price for each. Customers choose their area at checkout. If you add no zones, shipping is free and no area is asked.
settingsPage.errZone: Every zone needs a name and a price.
settingsPage.customHelp: Add your own questions (for example a gift message or a preferred delivery time). They appear at the end of the checkout form, in this order.
settingsPage.optionsLabel: Options (one per line, add the Arabic after |)
settingsPage.errCustom: Every extra field needs a label, and a drop-down list needs at least one option.
settingsPage.alertsHelp: Get a Telegram message the moment an order arrives. It is free and instant, and the whole team can be in one group.
settingsPage.alertsSteps: Add your order bot to your team's Telegram group (or send the bot a message), press “Find my chat” and pick it, then press “Send a test message”. Don't forget to save.
settingsPage.noChats: No chat found yet. Add the bot to your group, write a message there, then try again.
settingsPage.alertTestFail: Could not send. Check the chat ID, and that the bot is in the group.
settingsPage.alertNotConfigured: Alerts aren't switched on for this site yet (the bot key is missing).
settingsPage.phoneCodeHint: Egypt is 20. Local numbers like 010... get this code added in front.
settingsPage.autoplay: Change pictures automatically (visitors can always use the arrows or swipe)

errors.generic: Something went wrong placing your order. Please try again.
errors.fillAll: Please fill in your name, phone, and address.
errors.BAD_PHONE: Please enter a valid phone number.
errors.BAD_ITEM: Something in your cart is invalid. Please review it.
errors.TOO_MANY: You can order up to {{max}} of each item.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Sorry, one of the items in your cart is no longer available.
errors.OUT_OF_STOCK_PARTIAL: Sorry, only {{stock}} of "{{name}}" left in stock.
errors.BAD_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.BAD_ZONE: This delivery area is not available. Please choose another.
errors.PROMO_LIMIT: This promo code has reached its usage limit.
errors.PROMO_MIN_ORDER: This code needs an order of at least {{min}}.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.help: Create discount codes. Customers type a code at checkout and see the discount before they order. You can turn a code off at any time.
promos.badCode: Enter a valid code (2–30 letters, numbers, - or _).
promos.badValue: Enter a valid value (a percentage can't be above 100).
promos.badMin: Enter a valid minimum order (or leave it empty).
promos.badLimit: The usage limit must be at least 1 (or leave it empty).
promos.saveFailed: Could not save the code. Please try again.

upload.failed: Upload failed. Try again or paste a link.
upload.tooBig: This picture is too large (the limit is 8 MB).
upload.notSetUp: Picture upload isn't switched on yet. Paste a picture link instead.

options.title: Options (colors, activity, extensions...)
options.help: Let customers customize the product. Each choice can change the price. Stock is shared by all choices, so use "Preorder" for made-to-order products.
options.costHint: Costs are private: customers never see them. They are used for your profit report.
options.errInvalid: Every option needs a name, and a color or choice list needs at least one named choice.
options.valueImage: Picture for this choice (optional): the product photo changes to it when picked
options.askText: Ask the customer to type a word or comment when this box is ticked
options.textRequired: The customer must type something when ticked

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The page didn't load properly. Please try again.

team.title: Team
team.help: Give each person their own email and password, and choose what they can do. Nobody shares a login. A shop can have several owners (partners).
team.blocked: This account has been switched off. Please contact the shop owner.
team.noAccess: Your role doesn't have access to this page.
team.roleHelp_owner: everything, including the team and the shop settings
team.roleHelp_manager: products, orders, expenses, promo codes and reports
team.roleHelp_staff: orders only (move them along, fix customer details)
team.confirmOff: Switch off {{name}}? They will be signed out and won't be able to log in.
team.linkHelp: Send this link to {{name}}. It lets them choose their own password. Only they should receive it.
team.shareMessage: Hello {{name}}, you've been added to the {{shop}} admin. Open this link to choose your password, then sign in with your email: {{link}}
team.name: Name

err.BAD_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
err.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already belongs to another shop.
err.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already on your team.
err.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own account here.
err.FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can manage the team.
err.AUTH_PERMISSION: The server isn't allowed to create logins yet. Add the role "Firebase Authentication Admin" to its Google account (see the setup steps).
err.SERVER: Something went wrong. Please try again.

team.ownersNote: Owners can do everything, including adding or removing other owners and changing the shop settings. Give this role only to partners you fully trust. Every change is recorded in the activity log.
team.confirmOwnerChange: {{name}} is an owner (a partner). Change their access? This is recorded in the activity log.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: Who changed what, and when. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the activity log.
